errors.evidence: The description provides a detailed, point-by-point trace for each of the three lines. However, the x-coordinates, y-coordinates, and resulting trends described are almost entirely fabricated and do not match the data points shown in the plot. For example, for the 'Accuracy' line, the description lists points at x-values of 16, 20, 25, 30, etc., none of which (except the start and end) correspond to the actual data points located at irregular intervals (e.g., 15, 17, 18, 20, 22, 28...). The y-values are also incorrect. This hallucination of data applies to the descriptions of all three lines.
